title: Drop 01: Shiro.GRS
excerpt: Our first piece is a tribute to the GRS Hilux. Limited run, no restock.
body: Shiro means white. GRS is the Hilux that started this whole thing. The first Lowcal piece puts that truck front and center under the Throttle wordmark, with スロットル set above it.
It's a limited run. When it's gone, it's gone. Pre-orders are open now, and every order is picked, packed and handed over at a physical meetup, so you meet the people behind the brand.
Let our cars scream for us.

title: How meetup orders work
excerpt: Pre-order online, pick up in person. Here's the whole flow, start to finish.
body: 1. Pre-order your piece on the site and choose meetup or delivery at checkout.
2. We confirm your order by message within 24 hours and agree on a meetup spot and time.
3. Your order is picked and packed. You check the fit, pay or show your payment, and you're done.
Smart logistics, secure checkout, real people. That's the Lowcal way.
